start.speaker: Mom
start.text: Good morning! Professor Cedar was looking for you. He's at his lab next door.

start.speaker: Prof. Cedar
start.text: Ah, there you are! Are you ready for your own creature?

give_florbit.speaker: Prof. Cedar
give_florbit.text: Here is a Florbit! Take good care of it.

prof_quest.speaker: Prof. Cedar
prof_quest.text: I need a favor. Could you deliver this parcel to the Mayor in Riverbend City?

start.speaker: Mayor
start.text: Did you bring the parcel from Professor Cedar?

mayor_thanks.speaker: Mayor
mayor_thanks.text: Thank you! But we have a bigger problem... Rogues have taken over Route 2!
